repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供交互式开发者成长路线图，涵盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等数十个技术方向，辅以最佳实践指南与面试题库，帮助开发者系统规划职业路径并提升技能。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers interactive developer roadmaps across dozens of tech domains like frontend, backend, DevOps, AI, and data science, along with best practices and interview questions to guide career growth and skill development.

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
repos.summary_en: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

repos.description: This is the repo for Vue 2. For Vue 3, go to https://github.com/vuejs/core
repos.summary_zh: Vue 2 已于2023年12月31日终止维护，不再接收新功能、更新或修复。该仓库为 Vue 2 的归档版本，官方推荐新项目使用 Vue 3.x。Vue 是一个渐进式前端框架，核心库专注视图层，支持逐步采用，并拥有完善的生态系统（如 vue-router、vuex、vue-cli）。
repos.summary_en: Vue 2 reached End of Life on December 31st, 2023 and no longer receives updates. This repository is archived for Vue 2. The actively maintained version is vuejs/core. Vue is a progressive framework for building user interfaces, designed to be incrementally adoptable with a core library focused on the view layer and a rich ecosystem for large-scale applications.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design 是蚂蚁集团开源的企业级 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，提供高质量、可复用的前端组件与完整的设计系统。支持 TypeScript、主题定制、国际化及 SSR，适用于中后台管理系统开发，具备完善的开发工具链和丰富的设计资源。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library developed by Ant Group, offering a comprehensive set of high-quality, customizable components and design resources. Built with TypeScript, it supports internationalization, theme customization, SSR, and modern tooling for efficient enterprise application development.

repos.description: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever.
repos.summary_zh: Material UI 是一个基于 Google Material Design 的 React 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和主题系统，支持无障碍访问和响应式设计。它经过十年开源社区验证，稳定可靠，适合构建现代化 Web 应用，并通过 MUI X 扩展高级组件功能。
repos.summary_en: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library implementing Google's Material Design. It offers battle-tested, accessible, and responsive UI components with a customizable theme system. Trusted by global product teams, it extends functionality via MUI X for advanced use cases.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: screenshot-to-code 是一款 AI 驱动的工具，支持将截图、设计稿或 Figma 设计直接转换为高质量的前端代码（HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue），支持 Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 等先进模型，提供实验性视频录制转代码功能，适用于快速原型开发和 UI 自动化生成。
repos.summary_en: screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, mockups, and Figma designs into clean, functional front-end code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). It supports advanced models like Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5, with experimental video-to-code capabilities for rapid prototyping and UI automation.

repos.description: 🎉 A curated list of awesome things related to Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Vue.js 生态精选资源库，涵盖官方文档、实战教程、UI组件库、企业级应用案例及开发工具，为开发者提供从入门到进阶的完整学习路径与生产级解决方案。
repos.summary_en: A meticulously curated collection of Vue.js resources including official docs, tutorials, UI component libraries, enterprise case studies, and development tools, offering a complete learning path from beginner to production-ready solutions.

repos.description: 🎥      Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: Remotion 是一个基于 React 的视频编程框架，允许开发者使用 Web 技术（如 CSS、Canvas、SVG、WebGL）和 React 组件库来创建动态视频。它支持变量、API 调用、算法等编程能力，适用于个性化视频生成、数据可视化动画等场景，如 GitHub Unwrapped 年度报告。
repos.summary_en: Remotion is a React-based framework for programmatically creating videos using web technologies like CSS, Canvas, SVG, and WebGL. It enables dynamic video generation through programming logic, reusable components, and real-time preview, ideal for personalized content, data-driven animations, and automated video production.

repos.description: A Vue.js 2.0 UI Toolkit for Web
repos.summary_zh: Element 是一个基于 Vue.js 2.0 的企业级 UI 组件库，提供丰富的组件和完善的文档支持，适用于中后台管理系统开发。采用模块化设计，支持主题定制，具备完善的国际化方案，并拥有活跃的社区生态。
repos.summary_en: Element is a Vue.js 2.0 UI toolkit for web development, offering a comprehensive set of components and documentation for enterprise-level applications. It features modular architecture, theme customization, full internationalization, and an active community ecosystem.

repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: Cypress 是一款专为浏览器端应用设计的现代化端到端测试框架，提供快速、易用且可靠的测试体验。它支持实时重载、时间旅行调试和自动等待等特性，显著提升前端测试效率与稳定性，适用于现代 Web 应用的全流程自动化测试。
repos.summary_en: Cypress is a modern end-to-end testing framework designed for browser-based applications, offering fast, easy, and reliable testing. It features real-time reloads, time-travel debugging, and automatic waiting to enhance frontend test efficiency and stability, ideal for full-stack automation across modern web apps.

repos.description: Semantic is a UI component framework based around useful principles from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: Semantic UI 是一个基于自然语言原则的现代化 UI 组件框架，提供 50+ 组件、3000+ CSS 变量和三级变量继承体系，支持 EM 响应式设计和 Flexbox 布局，兼容 React/Angular 等主流框架，助力快速构建美观且可维护的前端界面。
repos.summary_en: Semantic UI is a modern UI component framework based on natural language principles, offering 50+ components, 3000+ CSS variables, and a three-level variable inheritance system. It supports responsive design with EM values and Flexbox, integrates seamlessly with React, Angular, and other frameworks, enabling rapid development of beautiful and maintainable web interfaces.

repos.description: :fireworks:Interactive Online Platform that Visualizes Algorithms from Code
repos.summary_zh: Algorithm Visualizer 是一个交互式在线平台，通过可视化代码将算法动态呈现，帮助学习者和开发者直观理解算法执行过程。支持多种编程语言，提供丰富的教程与可视化效果，适用于教学与算法研究。
repos.summary_en: Algorithm Visualizer is an interactive online platform that brings algorithms to life through code visualization. It supports multiple programming languages and offers engaging educational content, making algorithm learning intuitive and effective for students and professionals.

repos.description: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
repos.summary_zh: Dokploy 是一款开源、可自托管的 PaaS 平台，旨在替代 Vercel、Netlify 和 Heroku。它极大简化了应用与数据库的部署管理，原生支持 Docker Compose 与多节点 Swarm 集群，集成 Traefik 实现自动路由，并提供实时监控、多服务器管理及丰富的通知功能。
repos.summary_en: Dokploy is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS platform designed as an alternative to Vercel, Netlify, and Heroku. It simplifies application and database deployment with native Docker Compose support, multi-node Swarm clustering, integrated Traefik routing, real-time monitoring, and comprehensive multi-server management.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

repos.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
repos.summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
repos.summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

repos.description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

repos.description: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
repos.summary_zh: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
repos.summary_zh: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
repos.summary_en: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: The Developer Tool for Visual Engineers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers and Visual Engineers to design with Real Code.
repos.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

repos.description: A high quality UI Toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0
repos.summary_zh: iView 是基于 Vue.js 2.0 开发的高质量 UI 组件库，提供数十个美观实用的组件，支持 Vue 1.x 和 2.x、SSR、TypeScript、Electron 等，适用于企业级应用开发，文档详尽且提供丰富示例。
repos.summary_en: iView is a high-quality UI toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0, offering dozens of beautiful and practical components. It supports Vue 1.x/2.x, SSR, TypeScript, Electron, and provides extensive documentation with demos for enterprise-level applications.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 一个包含1324种健身动作的结构化多语言数据集，涵盖类别、目标肌群、器械、多语言指令及媒体ID。提供开发者向导，便于快速搭建健身应用后端、数据库及API。数据源自ExerciseDB，支持6种语言，适合健身应用开发、AI推荐及健康研究。
repos.summary_en: A structured multilingual dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises with categories, target muscles, equipment, step-by-step instructions in 6 languages, and media IDs. Includes a developer setup wizard for rapid backend, database, and API scaffolding. Ideal for fitness app development, AI recommendations, and health research.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: 全栈工程师培训材料
repos.summary_zh: 全栈工程师培训材料，系统讲解JavaScript全栈开发技术，涵盖前端React、Node.js后端及工程化实践，适合有HTML/CSS/JS基础的学习者，通过四讲课程帮助掌握Web应用前后端开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Comprehensive full-stack JavaScript training material covering frontend React, Node.js backend development, and engineering practices. Designed for learners with basic HTML/CSS/JS knowledge, featuring four lectures for a two-day bootcamp on building complete web applications.

repos.description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
repos.summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: Mobile UI elements for Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Mint UI 是一个专为 Vue 2.0 设计的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的移动端常用组件，支持全局注册和按需引入，具备轻量、模块化、易集成的特点，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Mint UI is a mobile-first UI component library for Vue 2.0, offering a suite of mobile-optimized components. It supports global registration and modular imports, with features like lightweight design, modularity, and easy integration, ideal for rapid mobile web development.

repos.description: a collection of simple demos of React.js
repos.summary_zh: 阮一峰 React.js 简易演示集，通过 13 个清晰示例系统讲解 React 核心概念，涵盖 JSX 语法、组件开发、状态管理、生命周期、表单处理及 Ajax 等，适合初学者快速上手 React 开发。
repos.summary_en: A collection of simple React.js demos by Ruan YiFeng, covering core concepts like JSX, components, state management, lifecycle, forms, and Ajax through 13 clear examples, ideal for beginners to learn React effectively.

repos.description: Material design for AngularJS
repos.summary_zh: AngularJS Material 是 Google Material Design 规范在 AngularJS (v1.x) 中的官方实现，提供轻量级、可复用的 UI 组件库，支持响应式布局和无障碍访问。项目已于2022年终止维护，推荐迁移至 Angular Material (v2+) 版本。
repos.summary_en: AngularJS Material is the official implementation of Google's Material Design specification for AngularJS (v1.x), offering a lightweight set of reusable, accessible UI components. Support ended in January 2022; users are advised to migrate to Angular Material (v2+).

repos.description: PLEASE READ THE PROJECT STATUS BELOW.  Native AngularJS (Angular) directives for Bootstrap. Smaller footprint (20kB gzipped), no 3rd party JS dependencies (jQuery, bootstrap JS) required. Please read the README.md file before submitting an issue!
repos.summary_zh: UI Bootstrap 是专为 AngularJS 设计的原生指令库，提供 Bootstrap 组件的轻量实现（仅20kB gzipped），无需依赖 jQuery 或 Bootstrap 的 JavaScript。项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至 ng-bootstrap 以支持 Angular 2+。核心优势包括模块化构建、与 AngularJS 深度集成及完善的动画支持。
repos.summary_en: UI Bootstrap provides native AngularJS directives for Bootstrap components with a minimal footprint (20kB gzipped), requiring no jQuery or Bootstrap JS dependencies. The project is now feature-complete and unmaintained, with migration to ng-bootstrap recommended for Angular 2+ users. Key features include modular builds, deep AngularJS integration, and ngAnimate support.

repos.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
repos.summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: An extended table for integration with some of the most widely used CSS frameworks. (Supports Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, Material Design, Foundation, Vue.js)
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Table 是一个功能强大的表格扩展插件，支持 Bootstrap、Semantic UI、Bulma、Material Design 等主流 CSS 框架。提供排序、分页、筛选、多选、卡片视图、详情视图等丰富功能，支持 AJAX 数据加载、本地化和扩展机制，适用于数据展示与交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Table is a feature-rich table extension for popular CSS frameworks like Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, and Material Design. It offers sorting, pagination, filtering, row selection, card/detail views, AJAX data loading, localization, and extensibility, making it ideal for dynamic data presentation and interaction.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: This is a Next.js, Tailwind CSS blogging starter template. Comes out of the box configured with the latest technologies to make technical writing a breeze. Easily configurable and customizable. Perfect as a replacement to existing Jekyll and Hugo individual blogs.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 博客模板，基于 App Router 和 React Server Components，集成 Contentlayer 管理 Markdown 内容。开箱即用，支持高度可定制，适合替代 Jekyll 和 Hugo 个人博客，提供现代化的技术写作体验。
repos.summary_en: A feature-rich Next.js and Tailwind CSS blogging starter template based on the App Router and React Server Components, using Contentlayer for markdown content management. Fully configured out-of-the-box, highly customizable, and ideal for replacing Jekyll and Hugo personal blogs with modern technical writing capabilities.

repos.description: A slide framework built for agents.
repos.summary_zh: open-slide 是专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，用户通过自然语言描述需求，Coding Agent 自动生成 React 组件。支持 1920×1080 固定画布、浏览器内审查、PPTX/PDF 导出及静态部署，实现从对话到精美演示文稿的无缝创作。
repos.summary_en: open-slide is an agent-native presentation framework where users describe decks in natural language and coding agents generate React slide components. It features a 1920×1080 canvas, in-browser inspector, export to HTML/PDF/PPTX, and static deployment for seamless deck creation from chat.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: A slide framework built for agents.
repos.summary_zh: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，支持通过自然语言描述生成 React 幻灯片。提供 1920×1080 固定画布、热重载、演示模式、元素标注编辑、静态导出等功能，内置资产管理和品牌 Logo 搜索，适用于自动化生成高质量演示文稿。
repos.summary_en: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents, enabling natural language-to-slide generation via React. It offers a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, hot reload, present mode, in-browser commenting, asset management with svgl logo search, and export to static HTML/PDF—ideal for automated, professional deck creation.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repos.summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
repos.summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

repos.description: A multi-model AI agent desktop client — connect any AI provider, extend with MCP & skills, control from your phone. Built with Electron + Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
repos.summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

repos.description: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
repos.summary_zh: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

repos.description: The open source Trello alternative.
repos.summary_zh: Kan是一个开源的Trello替代方案，采用Next.js与tRPC技术栈构建，支持看板权限控制、团队协作者邀请、Trello一键导入、标签筛选、活动日志追踪及自定义模板等功能，提供Railway一键部署与Docker Compose自托管两种方案，适合中小团队进行轻量级项目管理与任务协作。
repos.summary_en: Kan is an open-source Trello alternative built with Next.js and tRPC, offering board visibility control, team collaboration, Trello imports, labels, activity logs, and templates. Supports Railway one-click deployment and Docker self-hosting, ideal for small to medium teams seeking lightweight project management and task collaboration.

repos.description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
repos.summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
repos.summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

repos.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
repos.summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
repos.summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
repos.summary_en: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

repos.description: High-crafted UI libraries for AI agents: Border beam, Orbs, Metal, Gooey, Voice, Image, Avatar bots
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的高品质 React UI 特效库集合，包含 border-beam 动态边框光束、liquid-gooey 液态流体效果和 thinking-orbs 点阵加载动画。支持 React Native 与 SwiftUI 跨平台复用，采用 npm workspaces 多包管理，提供可视化演示站点与 CI 自动化发布流程。
repos.summary_en: High-quality React UI effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted orb loaders. Supports cross-platform React Native and SwiftUI ports. Built with npm workspaces for multi-package management, including hot-reload development and automated CI deployment.

repos.description: A lightweight Vue.js UI library with a simple API, inspired by Google's Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Keen UI 是一个轻量级 Vue.js 3 UI 组件库，采用简洁 API 设计，灵感来自 Google Material Design。它专注于交互式 JavaScript 组件，不依赖 CSS 框架，支持自定义主题与尺寸，并提供独立组件打包方案以优化体积。
repos.summary_en: Keen UI is a lightweight Vue.js 3 UI library featuring a simple API inspired by Google's Material Design. It focuses on interactive JavaScript-driven components without bundling CSS frameworks, supports theme and sizing customization, and offers standalone component builds for bundle optimization.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.description: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprises form builder and analytics platform that allows users to create questionnaires, exams, polls, quizzes, and analyze data online.
repos.summary_zh: XIAOJUSURVEY 是一套企业级表单构建与数据分析平台，支持问卷、考试、投票等多样化调研场景。基于 Vue3 + NestJS 技术栈，提供 40+ 题型、100+ 模板，具备智能逻辑编排、AI 生成问卷、分题统计与交叉分析能力，支持品牌化定制与多端嵌入，适用于市场调研、客户满意度测评等复杂业务场景。
repos.summary_en: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprise-grade form builder and analytics platform enabling creation of questionnaires, exams, polls, and quizzes with online data analysis. Built on Vue3 + NestJS, it offers 40+ question types, 100+ templates, AI-powered survey generation, logic rules, cross-analysis, and brand customization for market research, customer feedback, and educational assessments.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: weui for react
repos.summary_zh: React-WeUI 是基于 React 框架封装的 WeUI 组件库，提供与微信原生 UI 风格一致的移动端界面组件，支持 npm 安装与 CDN 引用，具备完善的文档与示例，适用于快速构建移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: React-WeUI is a React-based component library implementing WeUI's native WeChat UI design, enabling rapid development of mobile web interfaces with npm installation, CDN support, and comprehensive documentation.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: Collection of effects for React: Border beam, Liquid Gooey, Thinking orbs
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供两个 React UI 动效组件库：border-beam 实现流光边框动画，liquid-gooey 提供液态变形与流动特效。适用于现代 Web 应用视觉增强，支持源码热更新、独立 npm 发布与 CI 构建部署。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides two React UI animation libraries: border-beam for glowing border effects and liquid-gooey for morphing blob animations. Built with npm workspaces, supporting hot-reload source editing, independent package publishing, and automated CI deployment for modern web visual enhancement.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: Browser-native Office / PDF / CAD / archive viewer for internal web apps, with Vue, React, Svelte, jQuery, Web Components, and no server-side conversion.
repos.summary_zh: Flyfish File Viewer 是一款纯前端文件预览组件，支持 Office、PDF、CAD、压缩包等 208 种格式。它利用浏览器原生解析与渲染技术，无需后端转换，确保数据隐私与安全。支持 Vue、React 等主流框架，具备按需加载和私有化部署能力，适用于企业内部系统。
repos.summary_en: Flyfish File Viewer is a browser-native file preview component supporting 208 formats including Office, PDF, CAD, and archives. It leverages client-side parsing and rendering without server-side conversion, ensuring data privacy. Compatible with Vue, React, and other frameworks, it offers lazy loading and private deployment for enterprise internal systems.

repos.description: A tab bar that switches between scenes, written in JS for cross-platform support
repos.summary_zh: react-native-tab-navigator 是一个基于 JavaScript 的跨平台标签栏组件，专为 React Native 设计，支持 iOS 和 Android。它允许在多个场景间切换，提供自定义图标、徽章、标题等交互元素，兼容 React Native 0.16+，适用于构建原生级标签导航界面。
repos.summary_en: react-native-tab-navigator is a cross-platform tab bar component written in JavaScript for React Native, supporting iOS and Android. It enables switching between scenes with customizable icons, badges, and titles, compatible with React Native 0.16+. Ideal for building native-like tab navigation interfaces.

repos.description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
repos.summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
repos.summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

repos.description: Beautiful  UI components build with vue and ant design
repos.summary_zh: vue-beauty 是一个基于 Vue 和 Ant Design 构建的精美 UI 组件库，提供丰富的常用场景组件，采用组件化开发模式，封装复杂逻辑并提供简洁 API，内置样式优化与 ES 新特性垫片，支持现代浏览器，助力开发者快速构建美观的 Vue 应用。
repos.summary_en: vue-beauty is a beautiful UI component library built with Vue and Ant Design, offering a rich set of components for common scenarios. It follows Vue's component-driven architecture, encapsulates complexity with simple APIs, includes optimized Ant Design styling and ES polyfills, and supports modern browsers to accelerate Vue app development.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: An issue tracking tool based on laravel+reactjs for small and medium-sized enterprises, open-source and free, similar to Jira.
repos.summary_zh: ActionView 是一款基于 Laravel+React 的开源问题跟踪工具，专为中小型企业设计，功能类似 Jira。支持敏捷看板、甘特图、自定义工作流、权限管理、LDAP 集成、GitLab/GitHub Webhook 联动等，提供清晰代码结构和 Docker 部署方案，适用于轻量级项目管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: ActionView is an open-source issue tracking tool built with Laravel (backend) and React+Redux (frontend), targeting SMEs as a Jira alternative. It supports agile boards, Gantt charts, custom workflows, LDAP integration, GitLab/GitHub webhooks, and Docker deployment, offering clean code and extensibility for team collaboration.

repos.description: Animated border beam effect for React
repos.summary_zh: border-beam 是一个轻量级 React 组件，为卡片、按钮等元素提供动态流光边框动画效果。支持多种尺寸预设、颜色主题（彩虹/单色/海洋/日落）和强度调节，可自动适配明暗背景。通过 CSS @property 实现高性能 GPU 加速动画，不影响内容交互。
repos.summary_en: border-beam is a lightweight React component that adds animated glowing border effects to any element. It supports multiple size presets, color variants (rainbow/mono/ocean/sunset), and intensity controls. Automatically adapts to dark/light themes with GPU-accelerated animations using CSS @property, ensuring smooth performance without interfering with content interaction.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: vue2.0-tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource. It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

repos.description: A verified, community-maintained catalog of 981 open-source projects built with Jev.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Jev 是社区维护的开源项目目录，收录 640 个基于 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的类型决策模型）构建的项目，涵盖 SDK、AI 智能体工具、浏览器自动化、游戏模拟等 11 个类别。每个条目均标注具体决策点及可验证的公开证据，帮助开发者快速发现并评估真实参考实现。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Jev is a community-maintained catalog of 640 open-source projects built with Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions in software. Spanning 11 categories across SDKs, agent tooling, browser automation, games, and more, each entry identifies concrete decision points and links to verifiable public evidence for evaluating real implementations.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图海报生成工具，可将任意城市地图转化为精美的艺术海报。作为 Python CLI 工具的 Web 升级版，它无需安装，开箱即用。项目采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端，利用 Rust 编译为 WebAssembly 实现高性能图像处理，结合 Tailwind CSS 打造现代化 UI，支持全球主要城市的地图风格化设计。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map poster generator that transforms city maps into stunning artistic designs. As a web upgrade to the Python CLI tool, it requires no installation and is ready to use instantly. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust compiled to WebAssembly for high-performance image processing, paired with Tailwind CSS for a modern UI, supporting stylized map designs for major global cities.

repos.description: 此项目已停止维护，建议迁移到  https://github.com/museui/muse-ui/
repos.summary_zh: vue-carbon 是基于 Vue.js 1.0 开发的 Material Design 风格移动端 Web UI 库，提供丰富的组件如 Refresh Control、HeaderBar 等，支持 npm 安装与 webpack 集成，现已停止维护，推荐迁移至 Muse UI。
repos.summary_en: Vue-carbon is a Material Design style mobile web UI library built with Vue.js 1.0, featuring components like Refresh Control and HeaderBar. It supports npm installation and webpack integration but is no longer maintained; migration to Muse UI is recommended.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2026] MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research · 浏览器里运行的安卓模拟器 · Browser-hosted Android Simulator · Verifiable Evaluation · Scalable Online RL Training
repos.summary_zh: MobileGym 是一个基于浏览器的可验证、高并行移动 GUI Agent 研究仿真平台。它提供 28 个模拟应用和 416 个参数化任务模板，支持确定性亚毫秒级评测，单服务器可并行运行 256 个实例，并通过 Sim-to-Real 验证实现 +40.7 分真实设备性能提升。
repos.summary_en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, verifiable and highly parallel simulation platform for mobile GUI agent research. It ships 28 simulated apps with 416 parameterized task templates, deterministic sub-millisecond judges, 256 parallel instances per server, and achieves +40.7 pt sim-to-real transfer on real devices.

repos.description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

repos.description: AI generate code
repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
repos.summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: a sudoku game written in React Native
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
repos.summary_en: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

repos.description: HiApp written in react-native.
repos.summary_zh: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
repos.summary_en: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

repos.description: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

repos.description: Native AngularJS colorpicker directive. No dependency on jQuery or jQuery plugin is required.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个原生 AngularJS 颜色选择器指令，基于 bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery 库开发，无需依赖 jQuery。支持 Hex、RGB、RGBA 格式，可自定义位置、尺寸和事件，适用于 Bootstrap v3.x.x 项目，提供灵活的配置选项和丰富的交互事件。
repos.summary_en: A native AngularJS color picker directive based on bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery library, with no jQuery dependency. Supports Hex, RGB, RGBA formats, customizable positioning, sizing, and events. Ideal for Bootstrap v3.x.x projects with flexible configuration and rich interaction events.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: Flux AI Image generator
repos.summary_zh: Next Money 是一个基于 Next.js 14 的全栈 SaaS 启动模板，集成 Stripe 支付、Clerk 认证、Supabase 数据库、React Email 和 Shadcn/ui 等现代技术栈，专为快速构建商业化 SaaS 产品而设计，提供完整的用户管理、支付处理与邮件通知解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Next Money is a full-stack SaaS starter template built with Next.js 14, integrating Stripe payments, Clerk authentication, Supabase database, React Email, and Shadcn/ui. It accelerates SaaS development with ready-to-use user management, payment processing, and email notification features.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: A full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers  | 基于 TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板
repos.summary_zh: FlareStarter 是一款基于 TanStack Start 与 Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板。它集成了鉴权、Stripe 计费、邮件、i18n 及运营后台等核心模块，利用 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络实现毫秒级响应与极低成本。项目强调端到端类型安全，提供开箱即用的生产级代码，支持 fork 即用，旨在帮助开发者快速部署具备商业闭环能力的现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: FlareStarter is a full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers. It integrates essential modules like authentication, Stripe billing, email, i18n, and an admin dashboard. Leveraging Cloudflare's global edge network, it delivers millisecond latency and near-zero operational costs. Featuring end-to-end type safety and production-ready code, it enables developers to quickly deploy modern web applications with complete commercial capabilities.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.summary_zh: bestK/tv 是一个基于 Next.js 的现代化电视直播应用，支持多源直播流聚合、频道分类与搜索功能，提供响应式界面与 EdgeOne Pages 一键部署，适用于构建个人或社区级 IPTV 平台。
repos.summary_en: bestK/tv is a modern TV streaming app built with Next.js, featuring multi-source live stream aggregation, channel categorization, and search functionality. It offers a responsive interface and one-click deployment via EdgeOne Pages, ideal for building personal or community IPTV platforms.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个现代化的个人作品集网站，基于 Next.js、Tailwind CSS 和 TypeScript 构建，采用严格模式开发。支持 Markdown/MDX 内容发布，集成 RSS 订阅、站点地图、评论系统和阅读量统计，结合 Motion 实现流畅的滚动动画与视图过渡，性能优化出色，Lighthouse 评分接近完美，适用于开发者展示个人项目与技能。
repos.summary_en: A modern personal portfolio website built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript (strict mode). Features Markdown/MDX content publishing, RSS feed, sitemap, comment system, reading time, and view counter. Includes scroll-based animations via Motion for smooth UX, with near-perfect Lighthouse scores in performance, accessibility, and SEO. Ideal for developers to showcase projects and skills.

repos.description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt.js 3 构建的小红书工具网站，支持图文视频内容浏览、评论导出及下载功能，集成多代理轮换与本地数据持久化，提供现代化 UI 与完整代理配置，适用于内容采集与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: A Nuxt.js 3-based tool for browsing, exporting, and downloading Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) content including images, videos, and comments. Features modern UI, multi-proxy support, local data persistence, and automated browser interactions via Playwright.

repos.summary_zh: 魔法AI绘画是一个基于Next.js构建的跨平台AI绘画应用，支持多种主流AI模型（如Sora、DALL-E、GPT、GEMINI等）及自定义模型扩展。提供文生图、图生图、区域编辑和多图参考功能，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全，支持网页版与桌面应用部署。
repos.summary_en: Magic Image is a cross-platform AI painting application built with Next.js, supporting multiple AI models (Sora, DALL-E, GPT, GEMINI, etc.) and custom model integration. It offers text-to-image, image-to-image, region editing, and multi-reference image support, with all data stored locally for privacy. Available as both a web app and desktop application.

repos.description: A super blog lite -- just one page. use vue with github api !
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GitHub Issue 的单页极简博客系统，使用 Vue 和 GitHub API 构建，支持自定义配置与 CI/CD 自动化部署，适合个人知识管理与轻量级内容展示。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

repos.description: It is a materializecss.com implementation with Vue.js.
repos.summary_zh: material-ui-vue 是一个基于 Vue.js 的 MaterializeCSS 组件库实现，提供 Material Design 风格的 UI 组件封装。支持通过 npm 安装，需配合 MaterializeCSS 资源文件使用，适用于快速构建现代化前端界面，但当前版本为试验性质，稳定性未经验证。
repos.summary_en: material-ui-vue is a Vue.js implementation of MaterializeCSS, offering Material Design UI components. It can be installed via npm and requires MaterializeCSS assets including CSS, JS, and jQuery. Designed for rapid development of modern web interfaces, though marked as unstable and not recommended for production use.

repos.description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
repos.summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
repos.summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

repos.description: Nuxt full-stack blog.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt 的全栈博客系统，采用 MongoDB 存储、Cloudflare R2 图片存储和 Zeabur PaaS 部署，集成全文搜索、Markdown 编辑器、友链截图生成、评论系统等功能，支持 SEO 优化与主题切换，显著降低服务器成本。
repos.summary_en: A full-stack blog built with Nuxt, MongoDB, and Cloudflare R2, deployed on Zeabur PaaS. Features include full-text search, Markdown editor, friend link screenshot generation, Giscus comments, SEO optimization, and theme switching, reducing server costs by consolidating backend logic into Nuxt.

repos.description: An out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution
repos.summary_zh: i18n-pro/core 是一个开箱即用的轻量级 JavaScript 国际化自动翻译解决方案，支持文本提取、多平台自动翻译（如 Google、OpenAI、百度等）、增量更新和日志追踪，提供文本即键、变量插值、类型标签等功能，简化多语言开发流程。
repos.summary_en: i18n-pro/core is an out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution that supports text extraction, multi-platform translation (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Baidu), incremental updates, and logging. It offers features like text-as-key, variable interpolation, and type tags to streamline internationalization.

repos.description: 利用reactnative技术，开发，生成app
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 React Native 开发的移动端应用 demo，参考淘宝手机端 UI 设计，实现了包含首页、微淘、社区、购物车、个人中心等模块的 TabBar 界面。支持图标切换、角标提醒等功能，展示了 React Native 在跨平台 App 开发中的高效性和前端开发者上手友好的特点。
repos.summary_en: This project is a React Native-based mobile app demo, inspired by Taobao's mobile interface. It features a TabBar with modules like Home, Weitao, Community, Cart, and Profile, supporting icon switching and badge notifications. It demonstrates React Native's efficiency in cross-platform development and ease of use for frontend developers.
